Open-source tool

ComfyUI-DetailFixer

Fixes garbled logos, faces or any area you name in a generated image. Everything else stays untouched.

Role
Author

The brief

Generated images often get almost everything right and one thing wrong: the logo is garbled, a face is off. Regenerating the whole frame loses what was good. ComfyUI-DetailFixer fixes only the area you name. SAM 3 finds each area, an edit model regenerates just that area from a reference, and the result is blended back so the rest of the image is untouched.

What I did

  • Wrote the node in Python and published it as open source.
  • Used SAM 3 to find each named area: a logo, a face, anything you can describe.
  • Made the edit model switchable: local Qwen on a 10 GB GPU, or Nano Banana 2 / GPT Image 2 via API.
  • Blended each fix back so everything outside the area stays exactly as it was.

Tools

  • Python
  • ComfyUI
  • SAM 3
  • Qwen Image Edit
  • Nano Banana 2
  • GPT Image 2

How it works

One node. Everything outside the named area is left alone.
